items.title: Retail and Consumer Goods (Minneapolis's Defining Sector)
items.description: Minneapolis hosts more retail and CPG corporate headquarters per capita than any other US city. Target, Best Buy, General Mills, Land O'Lakes, Supervalu, Cargill's consumer brands, and dozens of mid-size retail and consumer products companies. ClickMasters builds: demand forecasting and inventory optimization (ML time-series models predicting product demand for Target's and Best Buy's complex multichannel inventory systems — national distribution center positioning, store-level forecast, and seasonal cycle modeling); product recommendation engines (collaborative filtering and content-based hybrid systems for Minneapolis retail companies' eCommerce, loyalty program, and in-store personalization programs); supply chain intelligence (disruption prediction, supplier risk scoring, and procurement optimization for the Minneapolis CPG supply chains that feed mass retail distribution); customer analytics (churn prediction, customer lifetime value modeling, and segmentation AI for retail loyalty programs).
